origin.description: Paste the deparsed lines with a space. A name is deparsed without backticks. A call uses them.

arguments.name: expr
arguments.text: A name, a literal, or a call.

arguments.name: width_cutoff
arguments.text: Accepted and ignored for these short expressions.

origin.details: The check is quote(`foo bar`) and quote(`foo bar` + 1).
origin.example:
bp_deparse1 <- getFromNamespace("deparse1", "backports")
print(bp_deparse1(quote(`foo bar`)))
print(bp_deparse1(quote(`foo bar` + 1)))
